rules.folder_structure: Recreate MGS-AGENTS and every descendant folder with identical names/paths under Shared Drive; map every old folder ID to new folder ID.
rules.file_move: Move individual files when canMoveItemIntoTeamDrive=true to preserve file ID and checksum.
rules.file_copy: Copy when move is blocked; verify size/hash and map old ID to new ID.
rules.source_safety: Do not remove source until full readback and approval.
